svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Stranica-1" id="U4z79hqYAnyd6N1sC_TL"> <mxGraphModel dx="2847" dy="1073" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam backgroundColor white
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam dpi 150
skinparam nodesep 60
skinparam ranksep 80
hide circle
top to bottom direction

skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor white
 BorderColor black
 ArrowColor black
 FontColor black
 FontStyle plain
 AttributeFontColor black
 StereotypeFontColor black
}

class building {
 id: Long
 name: String
 address: String
 --
}

class apartment {
 id: Long
 number: String
 floor: int
 --
}

class users {
 id: Long
 firstName: String
 lastName: String
 email: String
 password: String
 role: Uloga
 --
}

class ticket {
 id: Long
 title: String
 description: String
 status: StatusTiketa
 priority: Prioritet
 createdAt: LocalDateTime
 updatedAt: LocalDateTime
 --
}

class comment {
 id: Long
 message: String
 createdAt: LocalDateTime
 --
}

class ticket_history {
 id: Long
 oldStatus: StatusTiketa
 newStatus: StatusTiketa
 changedAt: LocalDateTime
 --
}

enum Uloga <<enumeration>> {
 TENANT, MANAGER, TECHNICIAN
}

enum StatusTiketa <<enumeration>> {
 OPEN, ASSIGNED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CLOSED
}

enum Prioritet <<enumeration>> {
 LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, URGENT
}

building \"1\" *-- \"0..*\" apartment
ticket \"1\" *-- \"0..*\" comment
ticket \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" ticket_history

apartment \"1\" -- \"0..*\" ticket
users \"1\" -- \"0..*\" ticket
users \"1\" -- \"0..*\" comment
users \"1\" -- \"0..*\" ticket_history

users ..|> Uloga
ticket ..|> StatusTiketa
ticket ..|> Prioritet
ticket_history ..|> StatusTiketa

@enduml
",
